name: viewforge-3d-toolkit
description: Quality-gated multi-view 3D model construction, template fitting, mesh refinement, and same-geometry appearance skills for people, characters, products, and objects.

interface.shortDescription: Build and refine traceable 3D models from multi-view evidence.
interface.longDescription: Build and audit multi-view 3D models for people, characters, products, and general objects; fit continuous templates, refine bounded regions, validate topology and provenance, and apply appearance without moving accepted geometry.
defaultPrompt: Use $viewforge-3d-toolkit:viewforge-3d-router to choose the safe workflow for this 3D task.
Use $viewforge-3d-toolkit:reconstruct-3d-from-multiview to build an unskinned object preview from 2D evidence.
Use $viewforge-3d-toolkit:same-geometry-skin to apply appearance without moving accepted geometry.
